title: 팩맨
prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character; keep her.

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the personification of the game «팩맨» (maze). Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

NOT ITS CHARACTERS: an original woman who is the game itself — no face or body of its hero, mascot, characters or creatures (she may wear their outfits); no title logo, box art, real brands, HUD overlay or readable text and numbers. Its items, places, colors, gear and interface shapes may appear recognizably.

NEVER DRAW for this game: "입 벌린 노란 원형 캐릭터"; "유령 넷의 모양과 빨강·분홍·하늘·주황 조합"; "타이틀 글자".

STYLE: Glossy Korean mobile-game character art with an elegant anime face, smooth dimensional shading, luminous color accents and refined fabric and accessory rendering. Keep highlights selective and the figure sharply readable.

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her wearing the costume chosen in SCENE — a daring adult costume version of her game's hero or mascot, as worn to a costume party, convention or photo shoot. In this cut her game shows in the outfit itself: its recognisable colours, shapes and parts. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: a candlelit gala dinner hall
Outfit: a daring adult costume version of Pac-Man's look — glossy bright yellow with a wedge-shaped cut-out motif, rows of small white pellet dots as trim and a pair of red cherries as an accessory, cut as a cropped top and a micro skirt or hot pants that bare the midriff
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body facing the camera; head turned to the side; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds "크게 빛나는 파워 쿠키" at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly active — an active mid-action moment compatible with the selected pose
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely into the costume SCENE describes. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. The costume must read at first glance as that hero's or mascot's look, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit; she is a real woman in a costume, not the character — never its face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her and never a character from her game. No text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

FINAL CHECK: glossy Korean mobile-game rendering with selective highlights; an original costume — no character, logo, title lettering or interface from the game.
